provenance.why: Independent limits for the Hulme (1982) floating-hemisphere reference, produced during the m17235 accountability audit of mission m17181 (CASE-BEM-HULME-HEMISPHERE). The mission's own results.json records that the published Hulme table digits were NOT AVAILABLE in the sandbox, so the reference it used is a re-derived multipole series; these numbers are the independent check of that series.
provenance.independent_code: capytaine 3.1.dev0 (Rankine panel method, installed as an optional dependency; never imported by src/)
provenance.independent_meshes: surface-piercing hemisphere R=1 m, immersed_part() of capytaine.mesh_sphere at resolutions (20,40)=400, (28,56)=784, (36,72)=1296, (44,88)=1936 faces
provenance.limit_method: 3-point Richardson extrapolation of the four-level ladder (geometric residual ratio r reported per cell)
provenance.body: surface-piercing hemisphere, radius a = 1.0 m, flat face flush with the mean free surface, deep water
provenance.normalisation: A/(rho*nabla), B/(rho*omega*nabla) with nabla = 2*pi*a^3/3 (exact displaced volume)
provenance.caveat: at the finest capytaine level the residual ratio is r = 0.62-0.76, i.e. the independent code is not fully converged; the extrapolated limit carries roughly +-1% uncertainty. The 3 % band asserted below is wider than that uncertainty and narrower than the 5 % case tolerance it is meant to police.
